Thin frame around window, keep cabin interior visually quiet and readable. Large integrated arched top carry handle and a small submarine periscope integrated into roof. Compact fins imply sky travel, no water, no ocean, no clouds, no scenery. Coherent single-volume silhouette like a cat-carrier-inspired personal flying submarine, NOT a bag placed atop a separate vessel. Full propeller, fins, handle and right nose visible with transparent padding. Landscape canvas approximately 3:2. Entire sprite on actual transparent background.
